hook: Octahedral MgO crystals with {111} faces store surface oxygen that boosts methane coupling into C2+ products.
summary: Magnesium oxide crystals exposing {111} faces outperformed conventional MgO in oxidative coupling of methane. Kinetics, operando Raman spectroscopy, and calculations point to surface-bound molecular oxygen that helps break C-H bonds and is used up during reaction, then restored by oxidation. The evidence is for one benchmark reaction on lab-scale catalysts.
title: MgO Facets as Regenerable Molecular Oxygen Reservoirs in Oxidative Coupling of Methane.
